text: Espectacular App, changue my life, mente de tiburon para lograr tus objetivos.
author: matias raben
negro con bazuca
developer_reply: You were right, and this one is on us: the listing promised unlimited habits while the app stopped at three. The listing has been corrected and the free version now tracks four habits, with the widgets, streaks and reminders included. Sorry for the wasted download — thanks for flagging it.

developer_reply: Hola Clara, gracias por avisarnos. Ya estamos trabajando para solucionar el problema del widget en la próxima actualización. ¡Un saludo!
